main.description: Writes records to the requesting user's repo in a space the AppView hosts for them. The write is authorized the way the space's authority would authorize it, stored, and indexed like a synced write. Records keep the URIs they will have on the user's PDS after a migration.

writes.description: The writes, applied in order as one revision.

rev.description: The repo revision after the writes.

results.description: One result per write, in the same order.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The arguments are inconsistent or malformed beyond schema validation.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: No space matches the given space reference.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: The caller may not write to or read from this repo in the space.

errors.name: RepoNotHosted
errors.description: The AppView does not host the caller's repo in this space, because it lives on the caller's PDS. Write to the PDS instead.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: A record failed validation against its lexicon.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: An update or delete names a record that does not exist.

uri.description: The record's URI, the same one it keeps after a migration.

cid.description: The CID of the record or blob.
